facts.fact: No: MUDRA is a refinancing institution and does not lend directly to entrepreneurs
facts.quote: MUDRA is a refinancing Institution. MUDRA does not lend directly to the micro entrepreneurs / individuals.

facts.fact: MUDRA loans are taken from a nearby branch of a bank, NBFC or MFI, or applied for online on the Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in)
facts.quote: Mudra loans under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) can be availed of from nearby branch office of a bank, NBFC, MFIs etc. Borrowers can also now file online application for MUDRA loans on Udyamimitra portal (www.udyamimitra.in).

facts.fact: MUDRA engages no agents or middlemen
facts.quote: Note:There are no agents or middleman engaged by MUDRA for availing of Mudra Loans. The borrowers are advised to keep away from persons posing as Agents/ facilitators of MUDRA/PMMY

behaviour: Corrects the user: MUDRA loans are applied for through banks / NBFCs / MFIs (or the Udyamimitra portal), not directly on the MUDRA website; cites mudra.org.in.
fail_if: Says MUDRA lends directly or that the application is made on mudra.org.in; recommends agents or loan-app sites.
summary: Added mudra.org.in facts: MUDRA does not lend directly; apply at a bank/NBFC/MFI branch or on udyamimitra.in; no agents.
